script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'harvest-repair',
  description: 'Repair 11 residual schema violations in mining harvest',
  phases: [{ title: 'Repair' }],
}
phase('Repair')
const r = await agent(`Run: /home/user/BookMinder/.venv/bin/python /home/user/BookMinder/.coordination/tools/validate_mining.py /home/user/BookMinder/.coordination/mining/v2/*.yaml — it reports ~11 violations across ~7 files. Fix EVERY violation in place:
- "quote NOT verbatim in source": open the cited source transcript (claude-dev-log-diary/day-NNN.md or scratchpad shard mining/v2/shards for day-020-sN with line-number prefixes), locate the passage via the loc field, and either (a) correct the quote to true verbatim text, or (b) if the text was actually the miner's paraphrase or contains stage-direction annotations like [Edit file], move the descriptive part out of the quote (into what_happened/statement) and retag the provenance field to user-paraphrase/agent-synthesis as appropriate — never leave non-verbatim text labeled as quote.
- "quote exceeds 3 lines": trim to the ≤3 most load-bearing lines (verbatim, use … for elision).
Re-run the validator until ALL files report OK. Then commit: git -C /home/user/BookMinder add (each fixed file by name) && commit -m "docs: repair harvest schema violations (verbatim/provenance fixes)" && push (retry with pull --rebase if rejected).
Return: list of fixes as file:field → what was wrong (verbatim-error vs mislabeled-paraphrase vs overlength), max 12 lines.`, { model: 'opus', effort: 'xhigh', label: 'repair' })
return r
result:
day-005.yaml:failure_modes[11].quote → verbatim-error: stage direction "[4 removed lines elided]" replaced with … elision; elided-lines note moved to what_happened
day-013.yaml:failure_modes[4].quote → verbatim-error: inline annotation "[frame borders elided]" removed from the WriteFile header line
day-016.yaml:failure_modes[4].quote → verbatim-error: "..." mid-sentence and "[Shell …]" bracket replaced with the real "✔  Shell sqlite3 …" frame line; truncation note moved to what_happened
day-016.yaml:failure_modes[5].quote → verbatim-error: "[Shell git restore …]" bracket replaced with verbatim "✔  Shell git restore docs/apple_books.md (…)" line
day-016.yaml:failure_modes[8].quote → verbatim-error: "[Edit …library.py]" header and "/"-joined diff lines replaced with the three verbatim numbered diff lines; file path moved to what_happened
day-016.yaml:failure_modes[9].quote → verbatim-error: "[Shell git add docs/*.jpg]" bracket replaced with verbatim tool line; wrapped prose re-joined to match source
day-018.yaml:skill_rules[16].quote → overlength: 5 lines trimmed to 3 by dropping the ```zsh fence lines
day-018.yaml:failure_modes[8].quote → overlength: 4 lines trimmed to 3 (dropped item 1, kept header + item 4)
day-018.yaml:failure_modes[8].user_intervention → verbatim-error (unflagged, fixed alongside): quote-marked text was invented; replaced with the real user turn at L5998
day-020-s1.yaml:skill_rules[18].quote → verbatim-error: elision "...;" mismatched source punctuation; corrected to "…," so both fragments are true verbatim
day-020-s2.yaml:philosophy[0].quote → verbatim-error: lowercase "our goal" vs source "Our goal"; capitalization restored
day-020-s5.yaml:skill_rules[13].quote/because_source → mislabeled-paraphrase: two compaction-summary bullets were "/"-joined; split into verbatim bullets with … elision and retagged user-paraphrase → agent-synthesis (because rewritten to name the compaction summary as the source)

Validator: all 24 files OK. Commit e89c304 pushed to claude/bookminder-recall-5ite2s.
